turns.content: For a Hohmann transfer from Earth to Mars, describe the transfer-orbit geometry and explain how the one-way travel time relates to the orbital period of that ellipse.
Use r_E=1.50e11 s and r_M=2.28e11 m to calculate the transfer semimajor axis.
Use G=6.67e-11 SI and M_sun=1.99e30 K to calculate the solar gravitational parameter and write the half-period formula.
Evaluate the transfer time in seconds and days.
Check whether the one-way duration should be reported using the half-period or the full period of the transfer ellipse.
Give the final report sentence with the transfer duration and its relation to the transfer ellipse.
